---
title: "Bond futures and the cheapest to deliver"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/book.R")
source("R/quantlib_side.R")
```

QuantLib has no bond future basis calculation in its R binding. The verdicts are against the results of the legacy text, at the end of the chapter. The reference rows use QuantLib for yields, durations, accrued amounts and cash flows, and the arithmetic of the legacy text in R for the basis.

## Inputs

The clean prices of the deliverable bonds are market data. They are read from the legacy text and not shown.

```{r}
#| label: inputs
valuation_date <- "2026-09-10"
delivery_date <- "2026-12-20"
futures_price <- 125.71
funding_rate <- 0.0123
year_fraction <- as.numeric(as.Date(delivery_date) - as.Date(valuation_date)) / 365
basket <- lagrange_object("part2_quantive_riemann/ch02_interest_rate_curves.qmd", "tbl_jgb_deliverable")
basket |>
  select(-bb_price) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4, caption = "Deliverable bonds")
show_inputs(list(
  valuation = valuation_date, delivery = delivery_date, futures_price = futures_price, funding_rate = funding_rate,
  bond = "6M, Japan, Actual/365 (Fixed), following payment, settlement 0 days", yield = "semiannual compounding"
))
```

## Current market

Baseline:

```{r}
#| label: baseline-call
ql_set_evaluation_date(valuation_date)
ql_dc <- QuantLib::Actual365Fixed()
ql_bonds <- pmap(list(basket$issue_date, basket$maturity_date, basket$coupon_pct), \(issue, maturity, coupon) {
  ql_fixed_bond(issue, maturity, coupon / 100, QuantLib::Japan(), ql_dc, settlement_days = 0L)
})
coupon_income <- function(bond) {
  GaussQuant::bond_cashflow_table_GQL(bond) |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
    filter(date > as.Date(valuation_date), date <= as.Date(delivery_date)) |>
    summarise(value = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    pull(value)
}
basis_table <- function(bonds, clean, futures, funding) {
  tibble(
    clean = clean, factor = basket$conversion_factor,
    accrued_start = map_dbl(bonds, \(b) QuantLib::Bond_accruedAmount(b, ql_date(valuation_date))),
    accrued_end = map_dbl(bonds, \(b) QuantLib::Bond_accruedAmount(b, ql_date(delivery_date))),
    coupon_income = map_dbl(bonds, coupon_income)
  ) |>
    mutate(
      dirty = clean + accrued_start,
      futures_invoice = futures * factor,
      gross_basis = clean - futures_invoice,
      funding_cost = dirty * funding * year_fraction,
      carry = coupon_income + accrued_end - accrued_start - funding_cost,
      net_basis = gross_basis - carry,
      implied_repo = (futures_invoice + accrued_end + coupon_income - dirty) / dirty / year_fraction
    )
}
baseline <- basis_table(ql_bonds, basket$bb_price, futures_price, funding_rate) |>
  mutate(
    yield = map2_dbl(ql_bonds, clean, \(b, p) {
      QuantLib::BondFunctions_yield(b, QuantLib::BondPrice(p, "Clean"), ql_dc, "Compounded", "Semiannual", ql_date(valuation_date))
    }),
    duration = map2_dbl(ql_bonds, yield, \(b, y) {
      QuantLib::BondFunctions_duration(b, y, ql_dc, "Compounded", "Semiannual", "Modified", ql_date(valuation_date))
    })
  )
```

RiemannFinMath:

```{r}
#| label: riemann-call
riemann_bonds <- pmap(list(basket$issue_date, basket$maturity_date, basket$coupon_pct), \(issue, maturity, coupon) {
  RiemannFinMath::fixed_rate_bond(
    settlement_days = 0L, face_amount = 100, effective_date = issue, termination_date = maturity, tenor = "6M", calendar = "japan",
    convention = "unadjusted", termination_convention = "unadjusted", rule = "backward", end_of_month = FALSE,
    coupon_rate = coupon / 100, day_count = "actual_365_fixed", payment_convention = "following", redemption = 100, issue_date = issue
  )
})
riemann <- RiemannFinMath::future_basket(
  riemann_bonds, basket$bb_price, futures_price, basket$conversion_factor, funding_rate, valuation_date, delivery_date
)
riemann_yields <- map2_dbl(riemann_bonds, basket$bb_price, \(b, p) {
  RiemannFinMath::yield_from_price(b, p, "clean", "actual_365_fixed", "compounded", 2L, valuation_date)
})
riemann_durations <- map2_dbl(riemann_bonds, riemann_yields, \(b, y) {
  RiemannFinMath::duration(b, y, "actual_365_fixed", "compounded", 2L, valuation_date, "modified")
})
```

`future_basis` is the same calculation for one bond:

```{r}
#| label: riemann-one
one <- RiemannFinMath::future_basis(
  riemann_bonds[[1]], basket$bb_price[1], futures_price, basket$conversion_factor[1], funding_rate, valuation_date, delivery_date
)
```

```{r}
#| label: results
baseline_name <- "QuantLib with R arithmetic"
issues <- paste("Issue", basket$issue)
bind_rows(
  compare_values(paste(issues, "net basis"), "per 100", baseline$net_basis, riemann$net_basis, baseline_name),
  compare_values(paste(issues, "implied repo"), "percent", 100 * baseline$implied_repo, 100 * riemann$implied_repo, baseline_name),
  compare_values(paste(issues, "yield"), "percent", 100 * baseline$yield, 100 * riemann_yields),
  compare_values(paste(issues, "modified duration"), "years", baseline$duration, riemann_durations),
  compare_max("Accrued at valuation, all issues", "per 100, largest", baseline$accrued_start, riemann$accrued_start),
  compare_max("Accrued at delivery, all issues", "per 100, largest", baseline$accrued_end, riemann$accrued_end),
  compare_max("Coupon income, all issues", "per 100, largest", baseline$coupon_income, riemann$coupon_income, baseline_name),
  compare_max("Gross basis, all issues", "per 100, largest", baseline$gross_basis, riemann$gross_basis, baseline_name),
  compare_max("Carry, all issues", "per 100, largest", baseline$carry, riemann$carry, baseline_name),
  compare_values("One bond: net basis, issue 373", "per 100", baseline$net_basis[1], one$net_basis, baseline_name),
  compare_values("Cheapest to deliver: row in the basket", "row", which.min(baseline$net_basis), which(riemann$ctd), baseline_name)
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Inverted curve scenario

```{r}
#| label: stress-inputs
stress_yield <- 0.08
stress_funding <- 0.09
show_inputs(list(standard_bond = "6% coupon, 2026-09-10 to 2036-09-10", yield = stress_yield, funding = stress_funding))
```

```{r}
#| label: stress-calls
ql_standard <- ql_fixed_bond("2026-09-10", "2036-09-10", 0.06, QuantLib::Japan(), ql_dc, settlement_days = 0L)
ql_stress_price <- function(b) QuantLib::BondFunctions_cleanPrice(b, stress_yield, ql_dc, "Compounded", "Semiannual", ql_date(valuation_date))
stress_futures_baseline <- ql_stress_price(ql_standard)
stress_baseline <- basis_table(ql_bonds, map_dbl(ql_bonds, ql_stress_price), stress_futures_baseline, stress_funding)

riemann_standard <- RiemannFinMath::fixed_rate_bond(
  settlement_days = 0L, face_amount = 100, effective_date = "2026-09-10", termination_date = "2036-09-10", tenor = "6M", calendar = "japan",
  convention = "unadjusted", termination_convention = "unadjusted", rule = "backward", end_of_month = FALSE,
  coupon_rate = 0.06, day_count = "actual_365_fixed", payment_convention = "following", redemption = 100, issue_date = "2026-09-10"
)
riemann_stress_price <- function(b) RiemannFinMath::clean_price(b, stress_yield, "actual_365_fixed", "compounded", 2L, valuation_date)
stress_futures_riemann <- riemann_stress_price(riemann_standard)
stress_riemann <- RiemannFinMath::future_basket(
  riemann_bonds, map_dbl(riemann_bonds, riemann_stress_price), stress_futures_riemann, basket$conversion_factor,
  stress_funding, valuation_date, delivery_date
)
```

```{r}
#| label: stress-results
bind_rows(
  compare_values("Futures price from the standard bond", "per 100", stress_futures_baseline, stress_futures_riemann),
  compare_values(paste(issues, "net basis"), "per 100", stress_baseline$net_basis, stress_riemann$net_basis, baseline_name),
  compare_max("Implied repo, all issues", "percent, largest", 100 * stress_baseline$implied_repo, 100 * stress_riemann$implied_repo, baseline_name),
  compare_values("Cheapest to deliver: row in the basket", "row", which.min(stress_baseline$net_basis), which(stress_riemann$ctd), baseline_name)
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Against LagrangeFinance

```{r}
#| label: lagrange
stress_prices <- map_dbl(riemann_bonds, riemann_stress_price)
keys <- function(name) paste0(name, ".", basket$issue)
bind_rows(
  against_lagrange_max("Yield, all issues", "percent, largest", keys("future.yield_pct"), 100 * riemann_yields),
  against_lagrange_max("Modified duration, all issues", "years, largest", keys("future.duration"), riemann_durations),
  against_lagrange_max("Accrued at valuation, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("future.accrued_start"), riemann$accrued_start),
  against_lagrange_max("Accrued at delivery, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("future.accrued_end"), riemann$accrued_end),
  against_lagrange_max("Coupon income, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("future.coupon_income"), riemann$coupon_income),
  against_lagrange_max("Gross basis, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("future.gross_basis"), riemann$gross_basis),
  against_lagrange_max("Carry, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("future.carry"), riemann$carry),
  against_lagrange(paste(issues, "net basis"), "per 100", keys("future.net_basis"), riemann$net_basis),
  against_lagrange(paste(issues, "implied repo"), "percent", keys("future.implied_repo_pct"), 100 * riemann$implied_repo),
  against_lagrange("Cheapest to deliver", "issue number", "future.ctd_issue", basket$issue[riemann$ctd]),
  against_lagrange("Scenario: futures price", "per 100", "stress.futures_price", stress_futures_riemann),
  against_lagrange_max("Scenario: price at 8%, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("stress.price"), stress_prices),
  against_lagrange_max("Scenario: gross basis, all issues", "per 100, largest", keys("stress.gross_basis"), stress_riemann$gross_basis),
  against_lagrange(paste("Scenario:", issues, "net basis"), "per 100", keys("stress.net_basis"), stress_riemann$net_basis),
  against_lagrange_max("Scenario: implied repo, all issues", "percent, largest", keys("stress.implied_repo_pct"), 100 * stress_riemann$implied_repo),
  against_lagrange("Scenario: cheapest to deliver", "issue number", "stress.ctd_issue", basket$issue[stress_riemann$ctd])
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Differences of wrapper and core

```{r}
#| label: design
tribble(
  ~Layer,    ~Aspect,            ~Baseline,                                       ~RiemannFinMath,
  "Wrapper", "Basket",           "A pipeline written by the caller",              "`future_basket` with a list of bonds",
  "Wrapper", "Coupon income",    "Read from a cash flow table and filtered",      "A column of the result",
  "Core",    "Basis arithmetic", "R, in the chapter",                             "Rust",
  "Core",    "Conversion factor", "An input",                                     "An input; set by the exchange"
) |>
  show_design()
```
